meta.title: Trixync Education — Coding Cohorts in Medan
meta.description: Cohort-based coding education in Medan for primary, junior high, senior high, and job seekers. Live 2-hour sessions, real projects, Demo Day. Practitioner-led — not slides.

hero.headline: Learn by building.
hero.subheadline: Practitioner-led coding cohorts in Medan — for your child from primary through senior high, plus a career track for fresh graduates. Live 2-hour sessions, real projects, Demo Day.

approach.title: Practitioners teach, students build
approach.subtitle: Every session is designed so students actually write code — not watch presentations. Parents can see progress through projects students bring home.

items.title: Every session is live
items.body: 2 hours, instructor-led. No slide decks pretending to be education.

items.title: Cohort-based, not self-paced
items.body: Students learn with peers, ship together, and present on Demo Day.

items.title: Python foundation, then specialize
items.body: Start with Python — then FastAPI backend or JavaScript/TypeScript full-stack when ready.

items.title: Portfolio from day one
items.body: From Builder onward, projects are real, shareable, and deployable.

programsSection.title: Six learning tracks + study-abroad prep
programsSection.subtitle: From primary school to job prep, plus a study-abroad syllabus (fully managed by Yanks and Brits — Trixync does not provide sessions).

pricing.title: Class fee — can be shared
pricing.subtitle: Price is for one class (max 3 students). One student can pay in full, or 2–3 can split so each pays less.
pricing.note: Micro-classes: maximum 3 students. The class fee stays fixed — more students (up to 3) means a lower cost per person.

collaboration.title: Build with schools, teams, and partners
collaboration.subtitle: Trixync works with institutions and organizations that want practitioner-led coding programs — not slide decks. Tell us what you're building toward.

partners.yanksAndBrits: Curriculum collaboration for Study Abroad Prep in Medan — taught by Winsten Coellins and Randy Brilliant Chandra. Trixync publishes the syllabus; delivery is managed by the partner.

items.title: Schools & campuses

items.title: Corporate training
items.body: Team upskilling and intern pipelines with the same production standards we use for clients.

items.title: Curriculum partners
items.body: Joint syllabi and program design — like our Study Abroad Prep collaboration model.

enrollment.title: Climb the ladder — or join where you are
enrollment.subtitle: Graduates of each tier are naturally ready for the next. Experienced students can skip ahead with assessments. Pro Track welcomes self-taught developers and bootcamp grads.
enrollment.windowsSubtitle: Enrollment is open year-round. Sessions are scheduled within the hours below — in-person in Medan, or online when needed.
deliveryItems: Git introduced at Tier 2, enforced from Tier 3
Deploy targets: Railway, Render, or Vercel

items.q: Do students need prior coding experience?
items.a: Tier 1 (Junior Explorer) and Tier 2 (Explorer) are open entry — no experience needed. Tier 3 can waive Python Core with an assessment pass. Pro Track is open entry with a skills assessment to place you correctly.

items.q: Is there a JavaScript / TypeScript course?
items.a: Yes. Builder Path B is a full JavaScript/TypeScript track: React & Next.js on the frontend, then Express or NestJS on the backend — after Python Core (or an assessment waiver).

items.q: What language is used in class?
items.a: Instruction is in Bahasa Indonesia. Code, docs, and tooling are in English — the same bilingual setup used in real developer work.

In-person in Medan, North Sumatra (venue confirmed per cohort). Online via Google Meet / Zoom is available for remote students or when needed. Hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM, closed Sunday.
Micro-classes: maximum 3 students per class — closer tutor attention and clearer progress for every learner.
Anytime. Enrollment is not limited to school holidays. Sessions are scheduled within operating hours (Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM; closed Sunday).

items.q: Why is pricing fixed this way?
items.a: The fee is for one class (not per person). If 2–3 students join, they can split the class fee so each pays less.

items.q: Is there a study-abroad preparation program?
items.a: Yes. Study Abroad Prep is a curriculum collaboration with Yanks and Brits Study Abroad Program in Medan. Trixync only publishes the syllabus here (foundation-year style Python Fundamentals I & II — different from Explorer & Python Core — plus Web Programming and Data Analytics). Trixync does not provide sessions; everything is managed by Yanks and Brits.

items.q: What do students walk away with?
items.a: Working projects, Demo Day presentation experience, and — for Pro Track — a polished GitHub, resume, LinkedIn, and alumni network access.
